measurement_definitions.resolver_call: One application-level resolver invocation; may produce zero or multiple DNS questions
measurement_definitions.dns_question: QNAME and QTYPE question; A, AAAA, CNAME follow-up and retries may multiply
measurement_definitions.network_packet: Actual transmitted UDP/TCP/DoH request and response; caching, fragmentation and retries prevent inference from higher-layer counts

options.name: Standard OS resolver
options.risk: Implicit getaddrinfo, A/AAAA, cache, CNAME, search suffix, retry, mutable runner
options.fail_closed: Cannot independently prove packet budget on stock hosted runner

options.name: Auditable application resolver
options.questions: Can track application-issued QNAME/QTYPE under explicit policy
options.packets: Cannot alone prove OS/network egress or downstream recursive packets
options.risk: Transport/library retries, fallback resolver, hidden DNS, CNAME expansion
options.fail_closed: Reject unapproved QTYPE/hostname/overflow; requires outbound isolation

options.name: Fixed resolution results
options.calls: May avoid resolver invocation if all layers honor override
options.packets: Zero intended, must be enforced by egress boundary
options.risk: Address changes, IPv4/IPv6, TLS hostname/SNI validation, stale mapping, implicit fallback
options.fail_closed: Require no fallback, pinned evidence and TLS identity; not suitable merely to bypass DNS evidence

options.name: Controlled network egress
options.packets: Can count/block outbound DNS at enforced boundary; does not imply recursive upstream packets count
options.risk: Hosted runner control limitations, encrypted DNS, proxies, sidecars and unexpected destinations
options.fail_closed: Default deny and enforceable per-protocol/host limits, stop before unobservable egress

selection.recommended: Auditable application resolver PLUS enforceable controlled egress, research only
selection.reason: Provides separate evidence for invocation, question, and boundary-observed packet classes; neither component alone proves end-to-end physical packet count
selection.fallback: If hosted runner cannot enforce outbound DNS/HTTPS boundary, retain BLOCKED and do not substitute inferred counts
pending: Define boundary and whether packet budget counts client-egress or full recursive chain
Verify feasible isolation on pinned runner image without live requests
Statically model A/AAAA, CNAME, cache, retry, fallback and hidden getaddrinfo cases
Specify separately approved DNS budget and one GET/time window only after evidence
